quotes.text: 17. Who cannot see, then, that salvation is the effect of faith ? for as we have previously observed, all the heavenly beings work by this principle, and it is because they are able so to do that they are saved, for nothing but this could save them. And this is the lesson which the God of heaven, by the mouth of all his holy prophets, has been endeavouring to teach the world. Hence we are told,…
